verdict.rationale: Graphite's AI privacy documentation states that its AI features are opt-in and do not store or train on your data. It adds that neither Graphite nor its subprocessors train on customer data, backed by contractual prohibitions on its Anthropic and OpenAI subprocessors. Organizations can also request a complete block of all AI features. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-training guarantee (e.g., audit or certification evidence).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: Neither Graphite nor any of its subprocessors use your data to train their models
are opt-in and do not store or train on your data
To disable AI features across your entire organization, please email support@graphite.com and request a complete block of all AI features for your organization.
